paragraphs.text: A. Z. Louise is a writer from Syracuse, New York, USA. Their background in civil engineering has been invaluable in their works of speculative fiction and poetry.

When not writing, they can be found knitting, playing folk harp, or weaving. They also offer sensitivity reading for representation of the following communities: Bisexual, AFAB Nonbinary, Black/Biracial, Bipolar Disorder, Depression, Anxiety, Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, Fat.
A. Z. Louise contributed to the Magic Story for Zendikar Rising .
